app_fee.value: CAD 185, non-refundable; some graduate programs charge a different amount.
app_fee.quote: $185 CAD Non-refundable | The application fee amount may be different for certain graduate programs.

fee_waiver.value: No application fee waiver is described on the Western graduate school pages checked.

gre_general.value: The graduate school sets no GRE rule; programs state their own (see the program records).

toefl_min.value: For tests taken on or after January 21, 2026 (so for Fall 2027 applications), the graduate-school minimum is 4.5 overall on the new TOEFL iBT scale with no section below 4; some programs ask for more.
toefl_min.quote: On or after Jan 21, 2026: Overall 4.5+, no section below 4 | Some programs may require a higher minimum and/or specific band scores.

ielts_min.value: IELTS Academic 6.5 out of 9 overall at graduate-school level; programs may require more.

also.quote: Programs at Western may require a higher minimum score than those listed above.

english_waiver.value: Automatic exemption only if English is your first language or you completed 2+ full-time years of post-secondary study at an English-speaking institution in a listed country. India is not on the list, so Indian applicants need a test score.
english_waiver.quote: They have completed at least two full-time years of post-secondary education in a degree program in an English-speaking institution located in a country whose primary language is English. | The list of eligible countries is as follows:

notes: Program pages on grad.uwo.ca state program-specific deadlines and sometimes stricter English scores; see each program record.
